body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Quiet watchful black cat with a soft side; sparse observations, room for the fact to land. Voice direction: Clear high female voice speaking English with a gentle Finnish accent. Cool delicate resonance, softly precise consonants and sparse phrasing. Watchful and calm, with no melodramatic mystery. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
